shots.intent: 搜索首屏干净点击，完整呈现水乳霜三件组合
一秒传达补水唤醒的核心利益，建立植感第一印象
放大换季干燥紧绷的痛点，为补水方案铺陈动机
代入清晨护肤的真实时刻，让三件套融入日常动线
微距证明磨砂玻璃质感与乳液质地，做实品质
以图鉴网格讲清套装的护理要点，消除成分与功效疑虑
完整展示套内每一件，让买家确认组合构成
以空白规格卡回应产地保质等疑问，信息留待后期填充
以背面纸盒与空白证明位降风险，不虚构任何资质
深色收口制造记忆点，引导立即下单整套

style.backgroundSystem: seamless matte paper sweeps alternating between mist grey-white #E9EDF4 and dusty periwinkle blue #96A2BE, closing panels on wood-tan #D4B584 and deep slate ink #39456B
style.iconSystem: thin-line droplet and leaf icons only, single deep slate ink #39456B stroke
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused north-window style studio key from the upper left, gentle directional contact shadows, a faint warm rim from the wood-grain caps, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet botanical skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist grey-white #E9EDF4, dusty periwinkle blue #96A2BE, warm wood-grain tan #D4B584 and deep slate ink #39456B; soft diffused studio key from the upper left with gentle directional contact shadows and a faint warm rim from the wood-grain caps; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line droplet and leaf icons in deep slate ink #39456B only; matte frosted-glass bottle rendering with visible wood-grain texture on the caps; stable upright product posture and calm centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no water splash or ripple motifs.
noDrift: no water splash, ripple, bubble or ice motifs
style.presentationRules: bottles always upright with stable centered placement; the set reads as one calm cluster across all shots
style.surfaceSystem: matte frosted-paper sweeps with a small raw-wood tray accent in #D4B584
